title: Perturbation of Fiedler vector: interest for graph measures and shape analysis
benchmark_measurement: Not applicable. The paper is about graph theory and shape analysis and does not conduct any benchmarks related to faith or religion.
findings: Not applicable. The paper does not contain any findings related to religion. Its findings relate to the properties of the Fiedler vector in graph theory and its application to the shape analysis of the corpus callosum.
